# Test List: 108-mcp-resilience

## Outer loop: acceptance behaviors

One per acceptance criterion in `spec.md`.

| id | behavior | traces | state |
| -- | -------- | ------ | ----- |
| A1 | the typed timeout error returns after roughly the configured duration (not 30s when 50ms is configured), the 30s default applies without an override, and a fast server is unaffected. | AC-1 | PENDING |
| A2 | the Nth failure opens the breaker, call N+1 returns `circuit-open` without touching the wire, after the cooldown the next call probes, a successful probe closes the breaker, a failing probe re-opens it, and a success in closed state resets the consecutive-failure count. | AC-2 | PENDING |
| A3 | the read-only tool is called exactly twice and the non-read-only tool exactly once, and a timeout is never retried regardless of the read-only mark. | AC-3 | PENDING |
